description.en: The request body that contains the LiveChannel configurations.

description.zh: 频道名称。不能包含斜杠（/）。
description.en: The name of the channel. The name cannot contain forward slashes (/).

descriptions.zh:
通过RTMP协议上传音视频数据前，必须先调用该接口创建一个LiveChannel。调用该接口会返回RTMP推流地址，以及对应的播放地址。
您可以使用返回的地址进行推流、播放，您还可以根据该LiveChannel的名称来发起相关的操作，如查询推流状态、查询推流记录、禁止推流等。
descriptions.en:
Before you upload audio and video data by using the RTMP protocol, call this operation to create a LiveChannel. This operation returns an RTMP ingest URL and the corresponding playback URLs.
You can use the returned URLs for stream ingest and playback. You can also perform related operations based on the LiveChannel name, such as querying the stream ingest status, querying the stream ingest history, and disabling stream ingest.
